_meta.rule: The banned item NEVER appears in the image. It arrives as a text overlay afterwards. generate.py enforces this with a blocklist and refuses to write a prompt that names one.
_meta.why: Two reasons. Legally a flatlay showing a vape reads as the account holding one. Practically soul_2 writes letter salad onto any printed surface, and every banned object in this niche is a printed object.
_meta.model: soul_2 for all of it. Checked in daya/CLAUDE.md: the text-capable model was only ever needed for little cards, and those are gone.
